Bill.BriefDescription: Promoting predictable funding for school districts that provide residential education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting predictable funding for schooldistricts that provide residential education; and adding a new sectionto chapter 28A.190 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.190RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The superintendent of public instruction shall submit to eachregular session of the legislature during an oddnumbered year a budgetrequest for residential education. (2) The superintendent of public instruction shall allocate fundingappropriated by the legislature for residential education to the schooldistricts that are required to conduct a program under this chapter. (3) Beginning with the 200910 school year, each school district'sallocation under this chapter may not be less than ninety percent ofthe amount allocated to that district for the previous school year.
